|sellprice = 500 |quality = false }} The '''Treasure Appraisal Guide''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be obtained by opening [[Artifact Trove]]s (≈3.57% chance). It can also be purchased from the [[Bookseller]] for {{Price|20000}} starting in Year 3 (≈9% chance to appear). The first reading grants the player a power that triples the sell price of all [[artifacts]]. Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s Menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 20 [[Skills|XP]] in each of the 5 skills. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Penny |like=Elliott |neutral=Abigail,Pierre,Caroline,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Jodi,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Sam,Leo,Wizard |dislike=Alex }} ==Bundles== Treasure Appraisal Guide is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Treasure Appraisal Guide is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a brown dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== Treasure Appraisal Guide is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Trading== One Treasure Appraisal Guide can be traded to the [[Bookseller]] for either 3 [[Spicy Eel]] or 3 [[Artifact Trove]]s, provided the player has already obtained the power from this book. ==References== See Data\Objects.xnb in the game files. See Data\Shops.xnb in the game files.
